meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会牵头一个由 5 名成员组成的“敌对”评审团队，让他们互相攻击彼此的想法和方案；之后只保留经得起攻击的意见，再交给专门的规划器把这些意见变成一份可执行的计划。这样规划会更严谨，薄弱假设和盲点更容易暴露。
howto.when: 当你说出「hyperplan」「hpp」「adversarial plan」等触发词，或要求对抗性交叉批评、严格审查计划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个项目
say.note: 会启动 5 人对抗评审，先互相攻击再提炼计划。

say.text: 启动 hpp 模式，对这份方案做交叉批评
say.note: 方案会被多角度攻击，只保留经得起反驳的部分。

say.text: 请用对抗性计划流程帮我制定发布计划
say.note: Claude 会组织对抗团队评审后交给规划器生成正式计划。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude becomes the lead of a 5-member adversarial team. The members ruthlessly attack each other's ideas; only the insights that survive are kept, then handed to a dedicated planner to formalize into an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "hyperplan", "hpp", "adversarial plan", etc., or ask for adversarial cross-critique planning with maximum rigor.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project.
say_en.note: Starts a 5-agent adversarial review, then distills a plan.

say_en.text: Run hpp mode and cross-critique this proposal.
say_en.note: The proposal gets attacked from multiple angles; only solid parts survive.

say_en.text: Help me make a release plan with adversarial planning.
say_en.note: Claude orchestrates the hostile team, then a planner formalizes the plan.
